response.original_title: Orchestre fédéral des jeunes d'Allemagne Young Euro Classic 2026
response.overview: The opening night of the 2026 Young Euro Classic festival brings together two rising stars of the classical music scene: conductor Aurel Dawidiuk and Georgian pianist Giorgi Gigashvili. Both aged 26, they will be performing with the German Federal Youth Orchestra.
